name: Defense Until Death Simulator
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Defense Until Death  Simulator        
                  
⚔️ Building Defense Tower, Summoning Soldiers. Let's join this Crazy Epic battle! 
   
💪 Collect：Soldiers, Towers.      
⚡ Equipment : Weapon, Shield, Cape, Armor, Helmet.      
👊 Skills.  
👍 Upgrade: Soldiers, Towers, Skills, Supply, Production. 

🧡There are many gems in this game and they are easy to obtain.

🧡 How to resist thousands of zombies and become a God?   
🌟 Set up Towers Behind your gate. 
🌟 Summoning Soldiers on the Battlefield. 
🌟 Don't die, otherwise your soldiers and towers will die too.  
🌟 Fighting Behind Your Soldiers. 
✨Prepare for glory!

✨ Codes: "1000LIKES", "3000LIKES", "5000LIKES" and "10000LIKES" next code will be unlocked at 30k TAG: Medieval, Sparta 300 heroes, Tower defense, Tower defense Simulator, Survive, Zombie
